I added a "Weather in Porto now" card to the App side of your Porto weekend note. I haven't opened it or run check_app, so I haven't seen it work, and I can't read the weather myself from here. The card is live rather than a fixed number written into the note.

- **What it shows:** temperature, conditions, feels-like, wind and humidity. It has a Refresh button.
- **Source:** Open-Meteo, which needs no API key. Amber Notes will ask you to approve that site the first time the card loads.
- **Your note's text:** unchanged.
